learning_outcomes.text: Provide information about nozzles, diffusers, turbines, and compressors.
Classify flow machines as axial and radial and apply the basic theory.

syllabus_topics: Compressible flow machines, stage and stage velocity triangles
Compressible flow (finding speed of sound, subsonic and supersonic flow)
Solving problems related to sound, subsonic, supersonic, nozzles and diffusers
Turbine stage, work, stage efficiency, turbine efficiency and infinitesimal stage efficiency
Thermodynamic analysis of multi-stage turbine and problem solving
Compressor stage, work, stage efficiency, turbine efficiency and infinitesimal stage efficiency
Thermodynamic analysis of multi-stage compressors and problem solving
Problem solving related to axial and radial turbines
Problem solving related to axial and radial compressors
bibliography: Turbines Compressors and Fans, S.M.Yahya, McGraw-Hill, 1998
